            q = deque([(r, c)])

            component = [(r, c)]
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < rows and 0 <= nx < cols and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
                        component.append((ny, nx))
            components.append((color, component))

                target_colors.add(color)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]

source = '''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen = set()
    target_colors = set()
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            size = 0
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                size += 1
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < rows and 0 <= nx < cols and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            if size > 1:
                target_colors.add(color)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    directions = ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1))
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or color in target_colors:
                continue
            around = []
            for i, (dy, dx) in enumerate(directions):
                ny, nx = r + dy, c + dx
                if 0 <= ny < rows and 0 <= nx < cols and grid[ny][nx] in target_colors:
                    around.append((i, grid[ny][nx]))
            replacements = set()
            for candidate in target_colors:
                dirs = [i for i, value in around if value == candidate]
                adjacent_pair = any((i // 2) != (j // 2) for k, i in enumerate(dirs) for j in dirs[k + 1:])
                if len(dirs) >= 3 or adjacent_pair:
                    replacements.add(candidate)
            out[r][c] = next(iter(replacements)) if len(replacements) == 1 else background
    return out
'''

rect_source = '''from collections import Counter, deque

def transform(grid):
    rows, cols = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    target_colors = set()
    seen = set()
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            color = grid[r][c]
            if color == background or (r, c) in seen:
                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])
            seen.add((r, c))
            size = 0
            while q:
                y, x = q.popleft()
                size += 1
                for dy, dx in ((1, 0), (-1, 0), (0, 1), (0, -1)):
                    ny, nx = y + dy, x + dx
                    if 0 <= ny < rows and 0 <= nx < cols and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            if size > 1:
                target_colors.add(color)
    rectangles = []
    for color in target_colors:
        for top in range(rows - 1):
            for bottom in range(top + 1, rows):
                valid = [all(grid[r][c] != background and (grid[r][c] == color or grid[r][c] not in target_colors)
                             for r in range(top, bottom + 1)) for c in range(cols)]
                support = [sum(grid[r][c] == color for r in range(top, bottom + 1)) if valid[c] else 0
                           for c in range(cols)]
                prefix = [0]
                for n in support:
                    prefix.append(prefix[-1] + n)
                for left in range(cols - 1):
                    if not valid[left]:
                        continue
                    for right in range(left + 1, cols):
                        if not valid[right]:
                            break
                        area = (bottom - top + 1) * (right - left + 1)
                        count = prefix[right + 1] - prefix[left]
                        if count >= 2 and count * 10 >= area * 7:
                            rectangles.append((top, bottom, left, right, color))
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top, bottom, left, right, color in rectangles:
        for r in range(top, bottom + 1):
            for c in range(left, right + 1):
                out[r][c] = color
    for r in range(rows):
        for c in range(cols):
            if grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] not in target_colors:
                # Non-object specks not claimed by any target rectangle are background.
                if out[r][c] == grid[r][c]:
                    out[r][c] = background
    return out
'''
